summary: Turn every section that holds a table and the word 'schedule' landscape (width and height swapped); the other sections, the margins and the words stay as they are. A file without such a section is left alone.
assumptions: a schedule is a section that holds a table and a paragraph with the word 'schedule' in it (any case) — chosen by what the section contains, so a specification's own section numbering does not matter
landscape swaps the page's width and height; the margins are not rotated (the left and right margins stay the left and right margins)
a header or footer the schedule shares with portrait pages keeps its right-aligned items where the portrait page puts them — flagged for review
a file without a schedule section is left alone (allow_missing)
